description.zh: 所有我方与敌方单位都在自己的格子里一下一下地被压扁再回弹（欠阻尼弹簧，会过冲成拉伸），同时持续自转；敌方单位边行进边弹。死亡后停弹跳、继续旋转。可配自定义音乐，默认关闭。
description.en: Every ally and enemy unit squashes and rebounds in place (an underdamped spring, so it overshoots into a stretch) while spinning continuously; enemies bounce as they walk. Death stops the bounce but keeps the spin. Optional custom music, off by default.
